title: Make progressive delivery the default worktree operating contract

acceptance.text: The governing rules require immediate main delivery after each verified bounded milestone.
Exclusive worktrees are limited to real isolation or concurrency needs and cannot accumulate verified work.
Regression coverage detects late-reconciliation behavior and focused governance tests pass.

skills.purpose: Convert the user-reported workflow failure into a small enforceable governance correction.

non_actions: Do not mutate reviewed data, source media, splits, feature authorities, or model artifacts.
Do not run video decode, detection, tracking, crop regeneration, GPU, or training.
Do not reset, clean, stash, delete, or stage the pre-existing .codex temporary runners.
risks: Do not weaken ownership, evidence, or safety gates while removing administrative delay.
Do not convert a policy-only correction into an unrelated manager redesign.

steps.summary: Encode progressive-delivery and limited-worktree rules with matching regression coverage.
Run focused governance validation and integrate the verified correction directly on local main.
